rules.name: Password Guessing (SSH Brute Force)
rules.description: Detected multiple failed login attempts. An adversary may be attempting to guess credentials.
rules.recommendation: Enforce strong password policies, implement Fail2Ban, and switch to public-key authentication.

rules.name: Suspicious Root Login
rules.description: A successful direct SSH login as root was detected. Direct root access is highly discouraged.
rules.recommendation: Disable PermitRootLogin in sshd_config. Require users to log in as standard accounts and escalate privileges via sudo.

rules.name: Sudo and Sudo Caching Abuse
rules.description: Unauthorized attempt to execute commands with elevated privileges via sudo.
rules.recommendation: Audit the /etc/sudoers file to ensure the Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP) is maintained.

rules.name: Account Manipulation (User Creation)
rules.description: A new user account was created. Adversaries may create accounts to maintain access to victim systems.
rules.recommendation: Verify if the account creation was authorized. Remove unauthorized accounts and audit existing users.

rules.name: Local Group Modification (Adding Admin Privileges)
rules.description: A user was added to a highly privileged group (sudo/wheel).
rules.recommendation: Validate the authorization of this privilege escalation. Revert changes if unauthorized.

rules.name: SSH Authorized Keys Manipulation
rules.description: An attempt to append a public key to the authorized_keys file was detected.
rules.recommendation: Inspect the ~/.ssh/authorized_keys file for unknown public keys and remove them.

rules.name: Cron Job Persistence
rules.description: Modification of cron jobs detected. Adversaries use cron to execute malicious payloads persistently.
rules.recommendation: Review current cron jobs using 'crontab -l' and audit files in /etc/cron.* directories.

rules.name: Systemd Service Creation or Modification
rules.description: Adversaries may create or modify systemd services to establish persistence or elevate privileges.
rules.recommendation: Audit recently created or modified .service files in /etc/systemd/system/.

rules.name: Bash Profile and RC Script Modification
rules.description: Modifying shell profile scripts allows an adversary to execute code upon user login.
rules.recommendation: Check the contents of ~/.bashrc and ~/.bash_profile for unauthorized commands.

rules.name: Clear Command History
rules.description: Adversaries may clear the bash history to hide evidence of command execution.
rules.recommendation: Forward shell history logs to a centralized SIEM immediately and make ~/.bash_history append-only.

rules.name: System Log Deletion
rules.description: Attempt to wipe or clear contents of critical system log files.
rules.recommendation: Isolate the machine immediately. Rely on forwarded logs in the SIEM for forensic analysis.

rules.name: Timestomp (Timestamp Manipulation)
rules.description: Adversaries may modify file timestamps to bypass forensic investigations and hide modified files.
rules.recommendation: Conduct a filesystem timeline analysis to identify anomalies around the timestomped files.

rules.name: Disable or Modify System Firewall
rules.pattern: ufw disable|iptables -F|systemctl stop firewalld|systemctl disable firewalld
rules.description: Commands altering or disabling the host firewall were executed.
rules.recommendation: Verify network security policies and ensure the firewall is actively running and properly configured.

rules.name: Disabling Security Tools (SELinux/AppArmor)
rules.description: Critical host-based intrusion detection/prevention systems were disabled.
rules.recommendation: Re-enable SELinux/AppArmor and investigate the actions performed immediately after disabling.

rules.name: Hidden File and Directory Creation
rules.description: Creation of hidden files or directories (starting with a dot) to conceal payloads.
rules.recommendation: Run 'ls -la' in the targeted directory to reveal hidden files and analyze their contents.

rules.name: Linux File and Directory Permissions Modification
rules.description: Making files immutable or granting excessive global permissions (777) or SUID bits.
rules.recommendation: Revert dangerous permissions and investigate the file modified.

rules.name: Rootkit / Kernel Module Loading
rules.description: Kernel modules were manually loaded or unloaded. This is a common technique for rootkits.
rules.recommendation: Compare currently loaded modules ('lsmod') with a known-good baseline to detect anomalies.

rules.name: Suspicious Interactive Reverse Shells
rules.description: Suspicious commands indicative of reverse shells or interactive shells were detected.
rules.recommendation: Isolate the endpoint immediately. Investigate active network connections for Command and Control (C2) activity.

rules.name: Fileless Execution (Web-to-Bash)
rules.description: Adversaries piped remote scripts directly into bash without saving them to disk (Fileless Execution).
rules.recommendation: Check the DNS queries or network logs for the remote domain/IP to identify the payload.

rules.name: Base64 Encoded Command Execution
rules.description: Commands were decoded from base64 and executed directly. Used to evade signature-based detection.
rules.recommendation: Extract the base64 string from the logs, decode it manually, and analyze the underlying payload.

rules.name: Ingress Tool Transfer (HTTP/S)
rules.description: Use of built-in utilities to download files from remote infrastructure.
rules.recommendation: Analyze the destination IP addresses or domains and inspect any downloaded files for malicious signatures.

rules.name: Ingress Tool Transfer (FTP/TFTP)
rules.description: Use of unencrypted file transfer protocols to download potentially malicious payloads.
rules.recommendation: Block outbound FTP/TFTP traffic at the firewall unless strictly required by business needs.

rules.name: Network Sniffing / Packet Capture
rules.description: Packet capture tools were executed. Adversaries use these to sniff credentials in clear-text traffic.
rules.recommendation: Ensure these tools are only accessible by authorized administrators. Restrict their execution.

rules.name: OS Credential Dumping (/etc/shadow)
rules.description: Attempt to read the /etc/shadow file which contains password hashes.
rules.recommendation: If unauthorized, assume credentials have been compromised. Force a password reset for all local accounts.

rules.name: SSH Private Key Extraction
rules.description: Accessing or copying SSH private keys. Adversaries use stolen keys to pivot to other machines.
rules.recommendation: Audit access to the keys. If compromised, revoke the keys and generate new key pairs.

rules.name: Bash History Scraping for Credentials
rules.description: Searching through bash history files looking for hardcoded passwords or API keys.
rules.recommendation: Educate users to never pass passwords via command-line arguments. Use environment variables or secrets managers.

rules.name: Local Account Discovery
rules.description: Commands used to enumerate local system users were executed.
rules.recommendation: Monitor the user executing these commands. While often benign, it is heavily used during the reconnaissance phase.

rules.name: System Information Discovery
rules.description: Adversaries may attempt to get detailed information about the operating system and hardware.
rules.recommendation: Correlate with other suspicious activities. This is often an automated script behavior post-exploitation.

rules.name: File and Directory Discovery (SUID Enum)
rules.description: Searching for files with SUID bit set. Attackers use this to find vulnerable binaries for privilege escalation.
rules.recommendation: Ensure no unintended binaries possess the SUID bit on the filesystem.

rules.name: Process Discovery
rules.description: Listing active processes to understand the environment or identify security monitoring tools.
rules.recommendation: Usually benign, but highly indicative of reconnaissance if executed shortly after an initial compromise.

rules.name: System Network Connections Discovery
rules.description: Listing active network connections and listening ports.
rules.recommendation: Monitor for subsequent network pivoting or lateral movement attempts.

rules.name: System Network Configuration Discovery
rules.description: Gathering network topology and routing information to prepare for lateral movement.
rules.recommendation: Network segmentation should be strictly enforced to limit adversary reach even if routing is discovered.

rules.name: Network Service Scanning (Pre-auth Disconnects)
rules.description: Multiple pre-authentication disconnections detected. Probable automated network scanner or enumeration tool.
rules.recommendation: Monitor the source IP. Consider adding the IP to perimeter blocklists or firewall drop rules if activity persists.

rules.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol (SSH/NC)
rules.description: Compressing files and immediately piping them over SSH or Netcat to exfiltrate data.
rules.recommendation: Investigate network flows to determine the destination IP and the volume of data exfiltrated.

rules.name: Data Destruction / Ransomware Behavior
rules.description: Highly destructive commands were executed aiming to wipe disks or securely delete vast amounts of data.
rules.recommendation: Immediately shut down or isolate the machine to halt the destructive process. Trigger Disaster Recovery (DR) protocols.
